decision: Extract from the clean source main into a new standalone repository
why: The operator wants OSS source and no implementation retained in the consumer

decision: Adopt the two supplied Rust engineering documents without rewriting them
why: Semantic contracts and ownership have priority over lint-only success
result: Copied verbatim; AGENTS.md routes agents to policy and memory

decision: Normalize publication copies and retain original object and content identities
why: Portable role labels must not destroy raw evidence or change its claimed scope
result: 110 tracked source files initially imported; source Git retains raw originals

decision: Use one Cargo workspace and root lockfile with existing crate boundaries
why: Native effects and reusable native/WASM commands have different dependency boundaries
result: No runtime redesign or performance improvement claimed

decision: Expose generic NixOS and Home Manager modules from the standalone flake
why: Consumers should own deployment settings rather than duplicate application code
result: Runtime gate remains false and autostart targets remain empty

decision: Parameterize the opt-in SSH harness and validate remote arguments
why: A portable test must not reuse another environment's identity, host, or immutable tool path
result: Live two-host rerun remains separately authorized and not executed

decision: Keep a std-only Rust verifier that records every configured command
why: A reviewer needs rerunnable commands and failures rather than an inferred green status
result: First portability check exposed two additional aliases in historical Nix logs; normalized those copies
